journey: Incident comms: tenancy-bounded blast-radius facts + attested "was I affected"

narrative.step: tenant A's metrics are scoped to A (blast-radius fact: a tenant sees only itself)
narrative.assertion: tenant A metrics: tenant=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000f0004 (its OWN signals only)

narrative.step: tenant B's metrics are a DIFFERENT tenant — a blast radius is bounded by tenancy, never cross-leaked
narrative.assertion: tenant B metrics: tenant=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000f0002 (!= A's 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000f0004) — "who is affected" is tenancy-bounded, not a guess

narrative.step: the attested "was my result corrupted by the incident?" evidence (the pubkey) is publishable
narrative.assertion: GET /v1/attestation/key → 200 (a customer verifies a verdict wasn't tampered — a cold/queued incident degrades speed, never correctness)

narrative.step: records the comms residual — the facts are live; the notification process is owner-gated
narrative.assertion: blast-radius facts (tenancy-bounded, single-region, attested) are supplied; the comms machinery is not

artifact.commsProcess: owner-gated (channel / SLA / templates — org deliverable, S11.5)
artifact.selfHeal: the honest "what to do" is usually "nothing, jobs self-heal" or "revert the label to fall to hosted"
